title: Can the RBI Really Save the Rupee? The Shocking Reality: Business Case study
description:

👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, iss mahine humari Indian currency ne apna all-time low hit kiya aur isse pure Indian market me tehlka mach gaya!! Aur iska sabse bada karan bataya jaa raha hai Donald Trump!!
Pichle 5 saalon me, yaani 2020 se lekar 2025 tak, humari Indian rupee dollar ke mukable 17% se gir chuki hai. Ab dekhne me toh ye sirf ek number hai, lekin business aur economic angle se dekha jaaye toh aapko ye jaanke herani hogi ki jab bhi Indian rupee ka value kum hota hai, iska seedha asar aapke savings par padta hai!!

Jaise Bharat apna 80% se zyada fuel import karta hai, toh agar apna currency ₹70 se ₹86 per dollar par chala jaaye, toh jo petrol aapko ₹90 me milta tha, woh ₹120 ya usse zyada tak pahunch sakta hai. Aur dollar ke mukable agar dollar sirf ₹0.5 bhi badhta hai, toh iska asar hamari zindagi par kaafi zyada padta hai. Sochiye, Bharat apne oil import ke liye har saal karib $160 billion kharch karta hai. Toh agar dollar ki value ₹0.5 se badhti hai, toh humare oil import ka kharcha ₹8,000 crore tak badh jaata hai!

Aur yeh toh sirf oil ki baat hai! Sochiye, petrol aur diesel ke daam ke badhne ka seedha asar transportation cost par padta hai. Aur jab transportation mehenga ho jata hai, toh groceries, vegetables aur daily-use items ke daam bhi badh jaate hain. Toh asaan bhaasha me bolun toh rupee ki value ke girne se Bharat me mehngai badh jaati hai!!

Isliye yeh sirf ek number nahi hai, doston. Yeh Bharat ki economy, businesses, aur aam insaan ki zindagi sab kuch impact karta hai! Toh sawaal ye hai:

Aakhir har saal Indian rupee girti kyu jaati hai?
Iska Bharat ki economy par kya asar padta hai?
RBI rupee ko bachane ke liye kya kar sakta hai?
Aur Donald Trump ka rupee se kya lena-dena hai?
Yeh sab jaanenge iss episode me!!
